stories.title: Clinch Watch — Cubs lost 8-2, magic number stays at 1
stories.angle: Cubs dropped Game 1 to Marlins 8-2 last night. Magic number remains 1 entering Game 2. One win tonight (or a D-backs loss) clinches back-to-back postseason trips. Shota Imanaga starts at 6:40 PM CT.

stories.title: PCA 40-40 — 45 HR / 39 SB, one steal from history
stories.angle: PCA is at 45 HR / 39 SB — moved to 39 SBs after stealing vs Reds on Sept 20. One steal from becoming only the 7th player in MLB history to hit 40-40. No Cub has ever done it. Final home stand.

x_posts.text:

Only six players all-time have done it. No Cub has ever. Tonight's last home stand is the stage.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Bregman injury — multiple facial fractures, won't miss playoffs
